nameJa: ソフト・ジオメトリック
conceptNote: 赤い面に、柔らかい幾何学的な白い文字を中央揃え。Chatの一階建てのaと丸い字形で親しみを持たせ、映像とチャットの輪郭を控えめに組み合わせる。
prompt:
Image dimensions: 1760 x 1120 pixels. Aspect ratio: 11:7. A compact landscape postcard.
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE finished typographic Chrome Web Store tile for YouTube Live Chat Fullscreen.
Concept03: soft geometric sans typography in warm white on a single FLAT rich vermilion-red field. Elegant approachable European culture-brand identity, typography-led, crisp and two-dimensional.
EXACT COPY, each phrase visible ONCE ONLY: "YouTube", "Fullscreen", "Live Chat". Respect capitalization. Fullscreen must stay one word. No additional text, labels, numerals, tagline or watermark.
Lettering is crucial: soft geometric humanist sans, medium or book weight with clean circular bowls, slightly rounded terminals, open counters, relaxed spacing, SINGLE-STOREY lower-case"a"in"Chat". The lettera should be a circular bowl and one short right stem, not the usual double-storey form. Make the typography feel custom-crafted and optically spaced, welcoming and sophisticated. NOT heavy black Helvetica/Arial, NOT a condensed display face, NOT childish rounded bubbletype. Flat white ink, no texture, bevel, shadow or outline on the letters.
Centered lockup with beautifully proportioned breathing room: "YouTube" in a confidently readable upper line with at least80pixel capital height; "Fullscreen" below as a large graceful single line; "Live Chat" on a third line in an equally graceful medium-weight size. Keep all text within8%safearea, and comfortably readable when the whole tile is220x140.
A secondary spare integrated video symbol sits below the text: a clean white16:9rectangle with four small fullscreen corners, a modest white play triangle on the left, and a simple white-outlined rounded chat bubble on the right entirelyINSIDE that same video rectangle. The bubble contains three short white strokes and a tiny speech tail. Keep the symbol appreciably smaller than the headline, centered, balanced and completely visible. It must explain video and livechat together rather than a sidebar.
Only vermilion and warmwhite, absolutely flat. No humans, photos, scenes, browser, dashboard, usernames, fake messages, glow, gradients, materials, paper layers, plastic, 3D, depth, shadows, ornaments, dots sprinkled around, clipart style or extra decorative panels. Refined letterforms and spacing are the core design.
headline: YouTube / Fullscreen / Live Chat
